title: retroglyph 0.0.9
text: retro_color_rgb() retro_color_rgba() now parse color grDevices::col2rgb() re-format grDevices::rgb(), instead slicing concatenating string. magick::image_raster() returns color specifications rather guaranteed hex, fully transparent pixel returns name "transparent", old string handling turned invalid "transpa" "transpaff". 0.0.8 fix addressed flattening entry point, several internal steps build images character matrices never pass retro_image_png(), error persisted platforms whose ImageMagick build retains alpha channel. Fixing helpers covers every path. Output unchanged hex input. Clarify retro_image_png() flattening onto white makes partially transparent source image tractable: blend reader sees color digitize, compositing interchangeable discarding alpha channel.

title: retroglyph 0.0.8

Removing alpha channel entry point means later step encounters non-hex pixel value.
